classification.difficultyReason: Read the roots from the sketch, form a quadratic with an unknown multiplier, determine it from another labelled point, and expand to general form.

content.prompt: Write the equation for the parabola shown in the sketch below in general form.

spec.description: Downward-opening parabola with four labelled points, unscaled axes and arrows on both branches.
spec.answerVisibility: All supplied points remain visible in the question; the equation appears only in answers.

answer.worked:
The zeros are $-1$ and $5$, so $y=a(x+1)(x-5)$. Using $(0,5)$:
$$\begin{align*}5&=a(0+1)(0-5)\\5&=-5a\\a&=-1\end{align*}$$
Hence
$$\begin{align*}y&=-(x+1)(x-5)\\y&=-(x^2-4x-5)\\y&=-x^2+4x+5.\end{align*}$$
